Marcos: Quick tiny poll — the mysterious plant on the 3rd shelf is giving me vibes. One-word name only. I nominate 'Spindle' :seedling:
Priya: Fernando? because it looks like it silently judges you.
Liam: Spindle gets my vote :+1:
Kara: I vote 'Professor' for maximum gravitas.
Chen: Also quick PSA — massive kudos to @Kara for rescuing the stapler from the planter yesterday :clap:
CoffeeBot: Reminder: Free cold brew in the kitchen until 3pm. :coffee: (don’t spill on Spindle)
Marcos: Tally so far — Spindle 2, Professor 1, Fernando 1. Looks like Spindle wins. Should we put a tiny name sticker on the pot? :sticker:
Priya: I can do a tag later. Confession: I sometimes water it with leftover coffee grounds. not sorry :sweat_smile:
Liam: That’s how legends grow. :trophy:
Kara: @Priya hero of houseplants. Also I brought mini sourdough bites for whoever wants one :doughnut:
Chen: Grabbing one now, thanks Kara!
Marcos: Quick kudos roundup: Kara for snacks, Priya for plant care and daring coffee-watering. Tiny awards (emoji + GIF) incoming. :tada:
